"""Fresh UUID APFS image ownership; never attach, format or detach an existing selected volume."""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
from pathlib import Path
import plistlib
import re
import shutil
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
import uuid

from tools.macos_detach_identity import VolumeBinding, registration, volume_binding
from tools.macos_busy_observer import observe_busy_image

_PLIST_LIMIT = 8 * 1024 * 1024
_DEVICE = re.compile(r"/dev/disk[0-9]+\Z")
_DETACH_ATTEMPTS = 3
_DEVICE_BUSY = 16
_NATIVE_ERROR_LIMIT = 65536
_VOLUME_DEVICE = re.compile(r"/dev/disk[0-9]+(?:s[0-9]+)+\Z")
_EVIDENCE_STRING_LIMIT = 512
_EVIDENCE_ENTITIES = 64
_EVIDENCE_STORES = 8
_DEVICE_NAME_LIMIT = 128
_EVIDENCE_INT_BITS = 128
_IDENTITY_PARTS = 2
_VOLUME_FIELDS = ("DeviceIdentifier", "DeviceNode", "VolumeUUID", "DiskUUID", "VolumeName", "FilesystemType",
                  "MountPoint", "Mounted", "ParentWholeDisk", "APFSContainerReference")


def entities(value: dict) -> list[dict]:
    """Reject malformed native entity lists rather than selecting a guessed device."""
    result = value.get("system-entities")
    require(isinstance(result, list) and all(isinstance(entry, dict) for entry in result),
            "Invalid image device metadata")
    return result


def image_device(value: dict) -> str:
    """Select the partition-map image device, never its separate synthesized APFS container."""
    devices = [entry["dev-entry"] for entry in entities(value)
               if isinstance(entry.get("dev-entry"), str) and _DEVICE.fullmatch(entry["dev-entry"])
               and entry.get("content-hint") in ("GUID_partition_scheme", "Apple_partition_scheme")]
    require(len(devices) == 1, "Image whole-device ownership is ambiguous")
    return devices[0]


def require(condition: bool, detail: str) -> None:
    """Refuse uncertain ownership and retain the fresh fixture rather than targeting another device."""
    if not condition:
        raise RuntimeError(detail)


def command(arguments: list[str]) -> bytes:
    """Fixed native programs only, no shell, with bounded accepted output and a joined timeout."""
    require(arguments[0] in ("/usr/bin/hdiutil", "/usr/sbin/diskutil", "/usr/bin/ditto", "/bin/sync"),
            "Unsupported owned-image program")
    result = subprocess.run(arguments, check=True, timeout=60, capture_output=True)  # noqa: S603 # nosec B603
    require(len(result.stdout) <= _PLIST_LIMIT and len(result.stderr) <= _PLIST_LIMIT, "Oversized native metadata")
    return result.stdout


def plist(arguments: list[str]) -> dict:
    """Decode native structured metadata; human-readable command text is never device authority."""
    value = plistlib.loads(command(arguments))
    require(isinstance(value, dict), "Invalid native image metadata")
    return value


def native_failure(error: subprocess.CalledProcessError) -> dict[str, object]:
    """Retain bounded native failure output even when a later ownership check refuses cleanup."""
    return {"returncode": error.returncode,
            "stdout": (error.stdout or b"")[:_NATIVE_ERROR_LIMIT].decode("utf-8", errors="replace"),
            "stderr": (error.stderr or b"")[:_NATIVE_ERROR_LIMIT].decode("utf-8", errors="replace")}


def _detach_failure(record: dict[str, object], phase: str, error: Exception) -> None:
    record.update(phase=phase, error=str(error)[:2048])
    if isinstance(error, subprocess.CalledProcessError):
        record["native_error"] = native_failure(error)


def _mountpoint_diagnostic(entries: list[dict], allowed: set[Path]) -> str:
    observed = "; ".join(str(entry.get("dev-entry", "<missing>"))[:128] + " -> "
                         + str(entry.get("mount-point", "<unmounted>"))[:512] for entry in entries[:8])
    expected = "; ".join(str(path)[:512] for path in sorted(allowed)[:8])
    return (f"Image escaped the private fixture mountpoint; observed [{observed}] "
            f"({len(entries)} entities); allowed [{expected}] ({len(allowed)} paths)")


def _evidence_fields(value: dict, names: tuple[str, ...]) -> dict:
    result, truncated = {}, []
    for name in names:
        if name not in value:
            continue
        item = value[name]
        if isinstance(item, str):
            result[name] = item[:_EVIDENCE_STRING_LIMIT]
            if len(item) > _EVIDENCE_STRING_LIMIT:
                truncated.append(name)
        elif item is None or type(item) is bool or type(item) is int and item.bit_length() <= _EVIDENCE_INT_BITS:
            result[name] = item
        else:
            result[name] = {"invalid_type": type(item).__name__}
    if truncated:
        result["truncated_fields"] = truncated
    return result


def _attachment_evidence(value: dict) -> dict:
    entries = entities(value)
    return {"image": _evidence_fields(value, ("image-path",)), "entity_count": len(entries),
            "entities_truncated": len(entries) > _EVIDENCE_ENTITIES,
            "entities": [_evidence_fields(entry, ("dev-entry", "content-hint", "mount-point"))
                         for entry in entries[:_EVIDENCE_ENTITIES]]}


def _identity_evidence(value: object) -> list[int] | None:
    if (isinstance(value, tuple) and len(value) == _IDENTITY_PARTS
            and all(type(item) is int and item >= 0 and item.bit_length() <= _EVIDENCE_INT_BITS for item in value)):
        return list(value)
    return None


def _volume_evidence(value: dict) -> dict:
    result = _evidence_fields(value, _VOLUME_FIELDS)
    if "APFSPhysicalStores" in value:
        stores = value["APFSPhysicalStores"]
        if isinstance(stores, list):
            result.update(physical_store_count=len(stores), physical_stores_truncated=len(stores) > _EVIDENCE_STORES,
                          APFSPhysicalStores=[_evidence_fields(item, ("APFSPhysicalStore",)) if isinstance(item, dict)
                                              else {"invalid_type": type(item).__name__}
                                              for item in stores[:_EVIDENCE_STORES]])
        else:
            result["APFSPhysicalStores"] = {"invalid_type": type(stores).__name__}
    return result


class OwnedImage:
    """Only one freshly created private image/device; uncertain detach leaves the scratch directory intact."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        if sys.platform != "darwin" or not os.getuid() or os.geteuid() != os.getuid():
            raise ValueError("Owned APFS validation requires unelevated native macOS")
        self.owned = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="filetree-apfs-owned-")).resolve(strict=True)
        self.anchor = self.owned.stat().st_dev, self.owned.stat().st_ino
        self.name = "FileTree-" + uuid.uuid4().hex
        self.image = self.owned / (self.name + ".sparseimage")
        self.root = self.owned / "volume"
        self.root.mkdir(mode=0o700)
        self._mountpoints = {self.root}
        self.identity: tuple[int, int] | None = None
        self.device, self.volume_uuid = "", ""
        self.attached = False
        self.attach_attempted = False
        self.detach_attempts: list[dict[str, object]] = []
        self._volume_device = ""
        self._attachment_evidence: dict | None = None
        self._checked_volume_evidence: dict | None = None
        self._unmounted_volume_device: str | None = None
        self._detach_binding: VolumeBinding | None = None
        self._unmounted_binding: VolumeBinding | None = None
        self._registered_entities: tuple[tuple[str, str], ...] | None = None
        self._wholly_unmounted = False

    def create(self) -> None:
        """Refuse overwrite: no -ov, existing image, mountpoint or block-device selector is accepted."""
        require(not self.image.exists() and not os.path.ismount(self.root), "Existing fixture target refused")
        command(["/usr/bin/hdiutil", "create", "-size", "1g", "-type", "SPARSE", "-fs", "APFS",
                 "-volname", self.name, str(self.image)])
        info = self.image.lstat()
        require(stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and info.st_uid == os.getuid() and info.st_nlink == 1,
                "Created image is not an owned ordinary file")
        self.identity = info.st_dev, info.st_ino
        self.image.chmod(0o600)

    def _image_check(self) -> None:
        self._scratch_check()
        info = self.image.lstat()
        require(stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and not info.st_mode & 0o077 and info.st_uid == os.getuid()
                and info.st_nlink == 1 and (info.st_dev, info.st_ino) == self.identity,
                "Owned image identity/permissions changed")
    def _scratch_check(self) -> None:
        anchor = self.owned.lstat()
        require(stat.S_ISDIR(anchor.st_mode) and not anchor.st_mode & 0o077 and anchor.st_uid == os.getuid()
                and (anchor.st_dev, anchor.st_ino) == self.anchor, "Owned scratch directory changed")

    def attach(self) -> None:
        """Mount only this freshly created image at its exclusive private mountpoint."""
        self._image_check()
        require(not self.attach_attempted and not os.path.ismount(self.root), "Repeated or existing attach refused")
        self.attach_attempted = True
        result = plist(["/usr/bin/hdiutil", "attach", "-plist", "-nobrowse", "-noautoopen", "-owners", "on",
                        "-mountpoint", str(self.root), str(self.image)])
        self.device, self.attached = image_device(result), True
        info = self.check()
        self.volume_uuid = info["VolumeUUID"]

    def _registered_attachment(self) -> dict:
        self._attachment_evidence = None
        self._unmounted_volume_device = None
        self._registered_entities = None
        self._unmounted_binding = None
        self._wholly_unmounted = False
        self._image_check()
        info = plist(["/usr/bin/hdiutil", "info", "-plist"])
        images = [entry for entry in info.get("images", []) if isinstance(entry, dict)
                  and entry.get("image-path") == str(self.image)]
        require(len(images) == 1, "Fresh image attachment is missing or ambiguous")
        entries = entities(images[0])
        self._attachment_evidence = _attachment_evidence(images[0])
        self._attachment_evidence.update(captured_image_identity=_identity_evidence(getattr(self, "identity", None)),
                                         captured_scratch_identity=_identity_evidence(getattr(self, "anchor", None)))
        require(image_device(images[0]) == self.device, "Owned image device changed")
        self._registered_entities = registration(entries)
        self._wholly_unmounted = all(entry.get("mount-point") is None
                                    or type(entry.get("mount-point")) is str and entry["mount-point"] == ""
                                    for entry in entries)
        return images[0]

    def _attachment(self) -> dict:
        image = self._registered_attachment()
        entries = entities(image)
        points = [entry["mount-point"] for entry in entries if entry.get("mount-point")]
        captured = getattr(self, "_volume_device", "")
        if (not points and isinstance(captured, str) and len(captured) <= _DEVICE_NAME_LIMIT
                and _VOLUME_DEVICE.fullmatch(captured)
                and sum(entry.get("dev-entry") == captured for entry in entries) == 1):
            self._unmounted_volume_device = captured
        if not points or not all(isinstance(point, str) and Path(point).resolve() in self._mountpoints
                                 for point in points):
            raise RuntimeError(_mountpoint_diagnostic(entries, self._mountpoints))
        return image

    def new_mountpoint(self) -> Path:
        """Register only a fresh private sibling for this image's additional owned APFS volume."""
        self.check()
        path = self.owned / ("peer-" + uuid.uuid4().hex)
        path.mkdir(mode=0o700)
        self._mountpoints.add(path)
        return path

    def check(self) -> dict:
        """Check image/device mapping, APFS identity and the exact private volume name/mountpoint."""
        require(self.attached, "Owned image is not attached")
        attachment = self._attachment()
        info = plist(["/usr/sbin/diskutil", "info", "-plist", str(self.root)])
        require(info.get("FilesystemType") == "apfs" and info.get("VolumeName") == self.name
                and info.get("MountPoint") == str(self.root) and os.path.ismount(self.root)
                and isinstance(info.get("VolumeUUID"), str) and bool(info["VolumeUUID"]),
                "Private APFS volume identity is unavailable")
        require(not self.volume_uuid or info["VolumeUUID"] == self.volume_uuid, "Private APFS volume was replaced")
        self._checked_volume_evidence = _volume_evidence(info)
        self._detach_binding = volume_binding(info, self._registered_entities, self.name, self.device)
        identifier = info.get("DeviceIdentifier")
        candidate = "/dev/" + identifier if isinstance(identifier, str) else ""
        if (not getattr(self, "_volume_device", "") and len(candidate) <= _DEVICE_NAME_LIMIT
                and _VOLUME_DEVICE.fullmatch(candidate)
                and sum(entry.get("dev-entry") == candidate for entry in entities(attachment)) == 1
                and any(entry.get("dev-entry") == candidate and entry.get("mount-point") == str(self.root)
                        for entry in entities(attachment))):
            self._volume_device = candidate
        return info

    def _post_busy_volume_evidence(self) -> dict:
        """Observe only the captured volume still uniquely registered in the checked unmounted image."""
        device = self._unmounted_volume_device
        captured = getattr(self, "_volume_device", None)
        expected = getattr(self, "volume_uuid", "")
        result = {"status": "not-eligible",
                  "device": device[:_DEVICE_NAME_LIMIT] if isinstance(device, str) else None,
                  "device_truncated": isinstance(device, str) and len(device) > _DEVICE_NAME_LIMIT,
                  "captured_device": captured[:_DEVICE_NAME_LIMIT] if isinstance(captured, str) else None,
                  "captured_device_truncated": isinstance(captured, str) and len(captured) > _DEVICE_NAME_LIMIT,
                  "expected_uuid": expected[:_EVIDENCE_STRING_LIMIT] if isinstance(expected, str) else None,
                  "expected_uuid_truncated": isinstance(expected, str) and len(expected) > _EVIDENCE_STRING_LIMIT,
                  "uuid_matches": None}
        if (not isinstance(device, str) or len(device) > _DEVICE_NAME_LIMIT or not _VOLUME_DEVICE.fullmatch(device)
                or device != captured or not isinstance(expected, str) or not expected):
            return result
        try:
            info = plist(["/usr/sbin/diskutil", "info", "-plist", device])
        except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
            result.update(status="read-failed", error=str(error)[:2048], exception_type=type(error).__name__)
            if isinstance(error, subprocess.CalledProcessError):
                result["native_error"] = native_failure(error)
            elif isinstance(error, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
                result["timeout_seconds"] = error.timeout
                result["outputs"] = {key: (getattr(error, key, None) or b"")[:_NATIVE_ERROR_LIMIT]
                                     .decode("utf-8", errors="replace") for key in ("stdout", "stderr")}
        else:
            observed = info.get("VolumeUUID")
            matches = observed == expected if isinstance(observed, str) and observed else None
            result.update(status="read", info=_volume_evidence(info), uuid_matches=matches)
            if (getattr(self, "_wholly_unmounted", False)
                    and info.get("MountPoint") in (None, "")
                    and (info.get("Mounted") is None or info.get("Mounted") is False)):
                self._unmounted_binding = volume_binding(info, self._registered_entities, self.name, self.device)
        return result

    def _record_detach_observations(self, record: dict, *, post_busy: bool = False) -> None:
        record["attachment"] = self._attachment_evidence
        record["checked_volume"] = self._checked_volume_evidence
        if post_busy:
            record["post_busy_volume"] = self._post_busy_volume_evidence()

    def _check_detach(self, record: dict, previous_busy: bool) -> None:
        expected = getattr(self, "_detach_binding", None)
        try:
            self.check()
        except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
            self._record_detach_observations(record, post_busy=previous_busy)
            if (not previous_busy or expected is None or self._unmounted_binding != expected
                    or self._unmounted_volume_device != expected.volume):
                raise
            self._registered_attachment()
            require(self._wholly_unmounted and self._registered_entities == expected.registration,
                    "Owned image registration changed during detach recovery")
            self._image_check()
            require(not any(os.path.ismount(point) for point in self._mountpoints),
                    "Owned mountpoint became mounted during detach recovery")
            record.update(mounted_check_error=str(error)[:2048], unmounted_identity_rechecked=True,
                          rechecked_attachment=self._attachment_evidence)
        else:
            self._record_detach_observations(record)

    def detach(self) -> None:
        """Bound checked verbose detach attempts; retain native output and any later refusal."""
        self.detach_attempts = []
        for attempt in range(_DETACH_ATTEMPTS):
            record: dict[str, object] = {"attempt": attempt + 1, "device": self.device, "phase": "checking"}
            self.detach_attempts.append(record)
            self._attachment_evidence = self._checked_volume_evidence = self._unmounted_volume_device = None
            self._unmounted_binding = None
            previous_busy = bool(attempt and self.detach_attempts[-2].get("native_error", {})
                                 .get("returncode") == _DEVICE_BUSY)
            try:
                self._check_detach(record, previous_busy)
            except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
                _detach_failure(record, "ownership-refused", error)
                raise
            try:
                output = command(["/usr/bin/hdiutil", "detach", "-verbose", self.device])
                record["native_stdout"] = output[:_NATIVE_ERROR_LIMIT].decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
                record["native_stdout_truncated"] = len(output) > _NATIVE_ERROR_LIMIT
            except subprocess.CalledProcessError as error:
                _detach_failure(record, "native-refused", error)
                if error.returncode != _DEVICE_BUSY or attempt == _DETACH_ATTEMPTS - 1:
                    if error.returncode == _DEVICE_BUSY:
                        record["busy_observation"] = observe_busy_image(
                            getattr(self, "image", None), self.device, getattr(self, "_detach_binding", None),
                            getattr(self, "_mountpoints", set()), self._image_check)
                    raise
                delay = .5 * (attempt + 1)
                record["retry_delay_seconds"] = delay
                time.sleep(delay)
            except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
                _detach_failure(record, "native-refused", error)
                raise
            else:
                record["phase"] = "native-succeeded"
                record["native_succeeded"] = True
                break
        try:
            info = plist(["/usr/bin/hdiutil", "info", "-plist"])
            require(not any(entry.get("image-path") == str(self.image) for entry in info.get("images", []))
                    and not os.path.ismount(self.root), "Owned image detach was not verified")
        except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
            _detach_failure(record, "verification-refused", error)
            raise
        record["phase"] = "verified"
        self.attached = False

    def cleanup(self) -> None:
        """Remove disposable fixture metadata only after verified detach; uncertain attachments are retained."""
        require(not self.attached and (not self.attach_attempted or bool(self.device)),
                "Uncertain image attachment retained")
        self._scratch_check()
        if self.identity is not None:
            self._image_check()
        for folder, directories, _files in os.walk(self.owned, followlinks=False):
            require(not os.path.ismount(folder), "Mounted fixture directory retained")
            for name in directories:
                require(not os.path.islink(os.path.join(folder, name)), "Linked fixture directory retained")
        shutil.rmtree(self.owned)

"""Read-only, fenced observations after the last owned APFS busy refusal."""

from __future__ import annotations

import base64
from collections.abc import Callable
from dataclasses import dataclass
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
import plistlib
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time

from tools.macos_detach_identity import VolumeBinding, registration, volume_binding

_SUPPORTED = sys.platform == "darwin"
_CLOCK = time.monotonic
_BUDGET = 10.0
_COMMAND_TIMEOUT = 2.0
_METADATA_LIMIT = 1024 * 1024
_OUTPUT_LIMIT = 65536
_IMAGE_LIMIT = 128
_PID_MAX = (1 << 31) - 1
_PROGRAMS = {"/usr/bin/hdiutil", "/usr/sbin/diskutil", "/usr/sbin/lsof"}


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class _Output:
    returncode: int | None
    stdout: bytes
    stderr: bytes
    timed_out: bool
    stdout_truncated: bool
    stderr_truncated: bool

    def summary(self) -> dict:
        return {"returncode": self.returncode, "timed_out": self.timed_out,
                "stdout_captured_sha256": hashlib.sha256(self.stdout).hexdigest(),
                "stdout_truncated": self.stdout_truncated, "stderr_truncated": self.stderr_truncated,
                "stderr_base64": base64.b64encode(self.stderr).decode("ascii")}


def _run(arguments: list[str], deadline: float, limit: int) -> _Output:
    remaining = deadline - _CLOCK()
    if remaining <= 0:
        raise TimeoutError("Owned-image observation budget exhausted")
    if arguments[0] not in _PROGRAMS:
        raise ValueError("Unsupported observation program")
    # Fixed read-only callers; anonymous owned files bound RAM even if native output is excessive.
    with tempfile.TemporaryFile() as stdout, tempfile.TemporaryFile() as stderr:
        try:
            result = subprocess.run(arguments, check=False, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=stdout,  # noqa: S603
                                    stderr=stderr, timeout=min(_COMMAND_TIMEOUT, remaining))
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            code, timed_out = None, True
        else:
            code, timed_out = result.returncode, False
        stdout.seek(0)
        stderr.seek(0)
        output, errors = stdout.read(limit + 1), stderr.read(_OUTPUT_LIMIT + 1)
    return _Output(code, output[:limit], errors[:_OUTPUT_LIMIT], timed_out,
                   len(output) > limit, len(errors) > _OUTPUT_LIMIT)


def _plist(arguments: list[str], deadline: float, observations: list[dict]) -> dict:
    output = _run(arguments, deadline, _METADATA_LIMIT)
    observations.append({"program": arguments[0], "operation": arguments[1], **output.summary()})
    if output.returncode != 0 or output.timed_out or output.stdout_truncated:
        raise ValueError("Incomplete owned-image observation metadata")
    value = plistlib.loads(output.stdout)
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise ValueError("Invalid owned-image observation metadata")
    return value


def _scope(image: Path, device: str, binding: VolumeBinding, mountpoints: set[Path],
           deadline: float, observations: list[dict]) -> dict:
    info = _plist(["/usr/bin/hdiutil", "info", "-plist"], deadline, observations)
    images = info.get("images")
    if not isinstance(images, list) or len(images) > _IMAGE_LIMIT:
        raise ValueError("Incomplete image registration inventory")
    matches = [item for item in images if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("image-path") == str(image)]
    if len(matches) != 1:
        raise ValueError("Owned image registration missing or ambiguous")
    attachment = matches[0]
    entries = attachment.get("system-entities")
    if (not isinstance(entries, list) or not all(isinstance(item, dict) for item in entries)
            or registration(entries) is None or registration(entries) != binding.registration):
        raise ValueError("Owned image registration changed")
    whole = [entry.get("dev-entry") for entry in entries
             if entry.get("content-hint") in ("GUID_partition_scheme", "Apple_partition_scheme")]
    if whole != [device] or binding.volume not in {entry[0] for entry in binding.registration}:
        raise ValueError("Owned image primary device is not registered")
    allowed = {str(point) for point in mountpoints}
    if any(item.get("mount-point") not in (None, "") and
           (not isinstance(item["mount-point"], str) or item["mount-point"] not in allowed) for item in entries):
        raise ValueError("Owned image mountpoint changed")
    volume = _plist(["/usr/sbin/diskutil", "info", "-plist", binding.volume], deadline, observations)
    if volume_binding(volume, binding.registration, binding.name, device) != binding:
        raise ValueError("Owned image complete volume binding changed")
    helper = attachment.get("process-id")
    return {"registration": [list(item) for item in binding.registration], "volume_uuid": binding.uuid,
            "volume": binding.volume, "container": binding.container, "stores": list(binding.stores),
            "helper_pid": helper if type(helper) is int and 0 < helper <= _PID_MAX else None,
            "helper_pid_invalid": "process-id" in attachment and not (type(helper) is int and 0 < helper <= _PID_MAX)}


def observe_busy_image(image: Path | None, device: str, binding: VolumeBinding | None, mountpoints: set[Path],
                       check_image: Callable[[], None]) -> dict:
    """Observe literal registered files only; failures never permit another detach or cleanup.

    A ten-second native-command budget starts after the final exit 16. Recheck the owned file,
    full registration and complete volume binding on both sides. Unelevated lsof is incomplete
    even with no output; neither PIDs nor associations establish the reason for native busy.
    """
    record: dict = {"status": "not-eligible", "incomplete": True, "scope_rechecked": False,
                    "cause_established": False, "native_budget_seconds": _BUDGET, "metadata": []}
    if not _SUPPORTED:
        record["status"] = "unsupported"
        return record
    if not isinstance(binding, VolumeBinding) or not isinstance(image, Path) or not mountpoints:
        return record
    deadline = _CLOCK() + _BUDGET
    stage = "scope-before"
    try:
        check_image()
        record["before"] = _scope(image, device, binding, mountpoints, deadline, record["metadata"])
        check_image()
        stage = "lsof"
        arguments = ["/usr/sbin/lsof", "-nP", "-F0pcftn", "-f", "--", str(image),
                     *(entry[0] for entry in binding.registration)]
        output = _run(arguments, deadline, _OUTPUT_LIMIT)
        record["lsof"] = {**output.summary(), "stdout_base64": base64.b64encode(output.stdout).decode("ascii"),
                          "literal_files": arguments[5:], "field_format": "NUL-separated p,c,f,t,n fields"}
        stage = "scope-after"
        check_image()
        record["after"] = _scope(image, device, binding, mountpoints, deadline, record["metadata"])
        check_image()
        record.update(status="observed", scope_rechecked=True)
    except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError, TypeError, OverflowError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
        record.update(status="observation-refused", failed_stage=stage,
                      exception_type=type(error).__name__, error=str(error)[:2048])
    return record

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
import re
import uuid

_DEVICE = re.compile(r"/dev/disk[0-9]+(?:s[0-9]+)*\Z")
_WHOLE = re.compile(r"/dev/disk[0-9]+\Z")
_ENTRIES = 64
_STORES = 8
_TEXT = 512
_DEVICE_TEXT = 128


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class VolumeBinding:
    """Complete device topology and canonical volume identity captured while mounted and owned."""

    volume: str
    uuid: str
    name: str
    container: str
    stores: tuple[str, ...]
    registration: tuple[tuple[str, str], ...]


def registration(entries: list[dict]) -> tuple[tuple[str, str], ...] | None:
    """Freeze every unique native device/hint; malformed or truncated topology is never authority."""
    if not 1 <= len(entries) <= _ENTRIES:
        return None
    result = []
    for entry in entries:
        device, hint = entry.get("dev-entry"), entry.get("content-hint", "")
        if (not isinstance(device, str) or len(device) > _DEVICE_TEXT or not _DEVICE.fullmatch(device)
                or not isinstance(hint, str) or len(hint) > _TEXT or "\0" in hint):
            return None
        result.append((device, hint))
    return tuple(sorted(result)) if len({device for device, _hint in result}) == len(result) else None


def _stores(info: dict, devices: set[str], image: str) -> tuple[str, ...] | None:
    values = info.get("APFSPhysicalStores")
    if not isinstance(values, list) or not 1 <= len(values) <= _STORES:
        return None
    stores = []
    for item in values:
        identifier = item.get("APFSPhysicalStore") if isinstance(item, dict) else None
        device = "/dev/" + identifier if isinstance(identifier, str) else ""
        if (len(device) > _DEVICE_TEXT or not re.fullmatch(re.escape(image) + r"s[0-9]+", device)
                or device not in devices):
            return None
        stores.append(device)
    return tuple(sorted(stores)) if len(set(stores)) == len(stores) else None


def _uuid(value: object) -> str | None:
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value or len(value) > _TEXT:
        return None
    try:
        parsed = uuid.UUID(value)
    except ValueError:
        return None
    return str(parsed) if parsed.int else None


def volume_binding(info: dict, entries: tuple[tuple[str, str], ...] | None,
                   name: str, image: str) -> VolumeBinding | None:
    """Require exact primary/container/store relationships in the complete owned registration."""
    if entries is None:
        return None
    devices = {device for device, _hint in entries}
    identifier, container_id = info.get("DeviceIdentifier"), info.get("APFSContainerReference")
    volume = "/dev/" + identifier if isinstance(identifier, str) else ""
    container = "/dev/" + container_id if isinstance(container_id, str) else ""
    stores = _stores(info, devices, image)
    volume_uuid = _uuid(info.get("VolumeUUID"))
    if (info.get("FilesystemType") != "apfs" or info.get("VolumeName") != name
            or len(name) > _TEXT or "\0" in name or volume_uuid is None or stores is None
            or len(volume) > _DEVICE_TEXT or len(container) > _DEVICE_TEXT
            or not _WHOLE.fullmatch(image) or image not in devices
            or not _WHOLE.fullmatch(container) or container == image or container not in devices
            or not re.fullmatch(re.escape(container) + r"s[0-9]+", volume) or volume not in devices
            or info.get("DeviceNode") != volume or info.get("ParentWholeDisk") != container_id):
        return None
    return VolumeBinding(volume, volume_uuid, name, container, stores, entries)

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from collections.abc import Callable
import ctypes
from dataclasses import asdict
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import time

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

from je_file_tree.core.capacity import capacity_ledger  # noqa: E402
from je_file_tree.core.export import _atomic_file  # noqa: E402
from je_file_tree.core.scanner import ScanOptions, scan  # noqa: E402
from je_file_tree.core.savings import estimate_savings  # noqa: E402
from je_file_tree.core.trash_size import trash_usage  # noqa: E402
from tools.macos_owned_image import OwnedImage, command, native_failure, require  # noqa: E402
from tools.volume_evidence import ledger_record  # noqa: E402

_MIB = 1024 * 1024
_BLOCK = 4096
_BIN_BYTES = 65536


def write_payload(path: Path, size: int, *, sparse: bool = False) -> None:
    """Create and flush only an exclusive disposable fixture."""
    with path.open("xb") as stream:
        if sparse:
            stream.seek(size - _BLOCK)
            stream.write(b"s" * _BLOCK)
        else:
            stream.write(b"p" * size)
        stream.flush()
        os.fsync(stream.fileno())


def file_record(path: Path) -> dict[str, object]:
    """Hash complete owned payloads and retain native allocation and identity separately."""
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        info = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
        digest = hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest() if hasattr(hashlib, "file_digest") else (
            hashlib.sha256(stream.read()).hexdigest())
    return {"identity": [info.st_dev, info.st_ino], "links": info.st_nlink, "logical": info.st_size,
            "allocated": info.st_blocks * 512, "flags": info.st_flags, "sha256": digest}


def fixtures(image: OwnedImage) -> dict[str, Path]:
    """Create native hard links, sparse/ditto-compressed data, clonefile data and a private uid bin."""
    image.check()
    folder = image.root / "owned-fixtures"
    folder.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    paths = {name: folder / name for name in
             ("plain", "alias", "all-a", "all-b", "sparse", "compression-source", "compressed", "clone")}
    for name in ("plain", "all-a", "compression-source"):
        write_payload(paths[name], 8 * _MIB)
    os.link(paths["plain"], paths["alias"])
    os.link(paths["all-a"], paths["all-b"])
    write_payload(paths["sparse"], 32 * _MIB, sparse=True)
    command(["/usr/bin/ditto", "--hfsCompression", str(paths["compression-source"]), str(paths["compressed"])])
    library = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
    library.clonefile.argtypes = [ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_int]
    library.clonefile.restype = ctypes.c_int
    if library.clonefile(os.fsencode(paths["compression-source"]), os.fsencode(paths["clone"]), 0):
        raise OSError(ctypes.get_errno(), "Native owned APFS clonefile failed")
    bins = image.root / ".Trashes"
    if not bins.exists():
        bins.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    info = bins.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) and info.st_dev == image.root.stat().st_dev, "Unsafe private bin parent")
    scope = bins / str(os.getuid())
    scope.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    paths["bin"] = scope / "owned-payload"
    write_payload(paths["bin"], _BIN_BYTES)
    records = {name: file_record(path) for name, path in paths.items()}
    require(records["sparse"]["allocated"] < records["sparse"]["logical"], "Native sparse allocation unavailable")
    require(records["compressed"]["flags"] & stat.UF_COMPRESSED
            and records["compressed"]["allocated"] < records["compressed"]["logical"],
            "Native compression was not verified")
    require(records["clone"]["identity"] != records["compression-source"]["identity"]
            and records["clone"]["sha256"] == records["compression-source"]["sha256"], "Native clone differs")
    return paths


def os_capacity(root: Path) -> dict[str, int]:
    """Native fragment counts; APFS container sharing is not independent reserved-byte measurement."""
    info = os.statvfs(root)
    return {"total": info.f_blocks * info.f_frsize,
            "used": (info.f_blocks - info.f_bfree) * info.f_frsize,
            "free": info.f_bavail * info.f_frsize,
            "unavailable_free": max(0, info.f_bfree - info.f_bavail) * info.f_frsize}


def ledger_proof(image: OwnedImage, paths: dict[str, Path]) -> dict[str, object]:
    """Compare file allocation and bin logical/allocated scopes while preserving native coverage errors."""
    image.check()
    result = scan(image.root, options=ScanOptions(workers=1))
    before = os_capacity(image.root)
    ledger = capacity_ledger(result.root)
    after = os_capacity(image.root)
    require(ledger.total == before["total"] == after["total"], "APFS total differs from native statvfs")
    for key in ("used", "free", "unavailable_free"):
        require(min(before[key], after[key]) <= getattr(ledger, key) <= max(before[key], after[key]),
                f"APFS {key} differs from bracketed native samples")
    nodes = {node.path: node for node in result.root.iter_files()}
    records = {name: file_record(path) for name, path in paths.items()}
    for name, path in paths.items():
        node = nodes[str(path)]
        require(node.size == records[name]["logical"] and node.allocated == records[name]["allocated"],
                f"APFS fixture allocation differs: {name}")
    inventory = trash_usage(str(image.root))
    require(inventory is not None and inventory.complete and inventory.count == 1 and inventory.size == _BIN_BYTES,
            "Private APFS uid bin query differs from the owned logical payload")
    require(ledger.recycle_bin_complete and ledger.recycle_bin_seen == records["bin"]["allocated"],
            "APFS bin ledger differs from owned allocated payload")
    require(ledger.metadata_bytes is None and ledger.omitted_bytes is None and ledger.other_volumes_bytes is None,
            "Unmeasured APFS ledger buckets must remain unknown")
    require(ledger.coverage.complete or ledger.unaccounted is None, "Incomplete APFS coverage published a remainder")
    return {"ledger": ledger_record(ledger), "native_before": before, "native_after": after,
            "fixtures": records, "bin_inventory": asdict(inventory), "bin_scope": "fresh image current uid only",
            "independent_shared_extent_bytes": None, "independent_reserved_bytes": None,
            "scan_errors": result.errors, "native_volume": image.check()}


def unlink_fixtures(paths: dict[str, Path], captured: dict[str, dict[str, object]]) -> None:
    """Recheck full owned identities/payloads, accounting only for this batch's own hard-link removals."""
    removed: dict[tuple[int, int], int] = {}
    for name, original in captured.items():
        expected = dict(original)
        identity = tuple(expected["identity"])
        expected["links"] -= removed.get(identity, 0)
        require(file_record(paths[name]) == expected, "Disposable recovery fixture changed")
        paths[name].unlink()  # only the exclusive private-image fixtures created above
        removed[identity] = removed.get(identity, 0) + 1


def recovery_proof(image: OwnedImage, paths: dict[str, Path], *,
                   record: Callable[[dict[str, object]], None] | None = None) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
    """Unlink only captured disposable fixtures; sample actual deltas without promising exact reclamation."""
    records = []
    cases = (("one_hard_link", ("alias",)), ("last_hard_link", ("plain",)),
             ("all_hard_links", ("all-a", "all-b")), ("sparse", ("sparse",)),
             ("compressed", ("compressed",)), ("clone_first", ("clone",)),
             ("clone_last", ("compression-source",)))
    for label, names in cases:
        image.check()
        tree = scan(paths["plain"].parent, options=ScanOptions(workers=1)).root
        require(not tree.error and all(node.error is None for node in tree.iter_nodes()), "Owned recovery scan failed")
        nodes = {node.name: node for node in tree.iter_files()}
        estimate = estimate_savings([nodes[name] for name in names], root=tree)
        require(estimate is not None and estimate.recoverable_min == 0
                and estimate.recoverable_max is not None and estimate.uncertain, "APFS recovery uncertainty lost")
        if label == "one_hard_link":
            require(estimate.recoverable_max == 0, "One hard-link name cannot release the surviving data")
        captured = {name: file_record(paths[name]) for name in names}
        kept = {name: file_record(path) for name, path in paths.items() if name not in names and path.exists()}
        command(["/bin/sync"])
        before = os_capacity(image.root)["free"]
        unlink_fixtures(paths, captured)
        command(["/bin/sync"])
        samples = []
        for _sample in range(4):
            samples.append(os_capacity(image.root)["free"] - before)
            time.sleep(0.1)
        for name, kept_record in kept.items():
            actual = file_record(paths[name])
            require(actual["identity"] == kept_record["identity"] and actual["sha256"] == kept_record["sha256"],
                    "Unselected owned payload/identity changed")
        actual = {"case": label, "estimate": asdict(estimate), "native_free_change_samples": samples,
                  "selected_before": captured, "unselected_sources_preserved": True,
                  "independent_shared_extent_bytes": None, "directory_metadata_bytes": None,
                  "delta_scope": "OS free change includes deferred reclamation and filesystem metadata"}
        records.append(actual)
        if record is not None:
            record(actual)
    return records


def save(evidence: Path, proof: dict[str, object]) -> None:
    """Preserve phase/failure evidence atomically, including retained owned fixture locations."""
    with _atomic_file(evidence / "proof.json", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        json.dump(proof, stream, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str)
        stream.write("\n")


def cross_volume_proof(image: OwnedImage) -> dict[str, object]:
    """Use production fcopyfile between the owned host scratch and its fresh APFS image."""
    from tools.validate_macos_sources import _copy_and_link, _sources  # noqa: PLC0415

    image.check()
    source, unused = _sources(image.owned)
    target = image.root / unused.name
    target.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    require(source.stat().st_dev != target.stat().st_dev, "Cross-volume fixture shares its source device")
    proof = _copy_and_link(source, target)
    proof.update(copy_scope="cross-volume", source_device=source.stat().st_dev,
                 target_device=target.stat().st_dev, finder_automation=False, trash_invoked=False)
    return proof


def main() -> int:
    """No existing-image selector; uncertain attachment/detachment never grants scratch deletion."""
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--evidence", type=Path, default=Path("macos-volume-evidence"))
    args = parser.parse_args()
    image = OwnedImage()  # platform/privilege refusal precedes any fixture or evidence creation
    proof: dict[str, object] = {"phase": "started", "owned": str(image.owned), "host_bins_modified": False,
                                "finder_automation": False, "cleanup_verified": False}
    args.evidence.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    save(args.evidence, proof)

    def record(value: dict[str, object]) -> None:
        proof.setdefault("recovery", []).append(value)
        save(args.evidence, proof)

    try:
        image.create()
        image.attach()
        proof.update(phase="attached", device=image.device, volume_uuid=image.volume_uuid)
        save(args.evidence, proof)
        paths = fixtures(image)
        proof["capacity"] = ledger_proof(image, paths)
        save(args.evidence, proof)
        recovery_proof(image, paths, record=record)
        proof["cross_volume"] = cross_volume_proof(image)
        save(args.evidence, proof)
        from tools.macos_apfs_peer import reservation_proof  # noqa: PLC0415

        proof["reservation"] = reservation_proof(image)
        proof["phase"] = "validated"
        save(args.evidence, proof)
    except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
        proof.update(phase="failed", error=str(error))
        if isinstance(error, subprocess.CalledProcessError):
            proof["native_command_error"] = native_failure(error)
        raise
    finally:
        try:
            if image.attached:
                image.detach()
            image.cleanup()
            proof["cleanup_verified"] = True
        except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
            proof.update(cleanup_error=str(error), retained_owned_fixture=str(image.owned))
            if isinstance(error, subprocess.CalledProcessError):
                proof["cleanup_native_command_error"] = native_failure(error)
        proof["detach_attempts"] = image.detach_attempts
        save(args.evidence, proof)
    require(proof["cleanup_verified"], "Owned APFS fixture retained; inspect phase evidence")
    proof["phase"] = "complete"
    save(args.evidence, proof)
    sys.stdout.write("Owned APFS capacity, bin allocation and recovery evidence complete.\n")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

from tools.macos_detach_identity import VolumeBinding, registration, volume_binding

_PLIST_LIMIT = 8 * 1024 * 1024
_DEVICE = re.compile(r"/dev/disk[0-9]+\Z")
_DETACH_ATTEMPTS = 3
_DEVICE_BUSY = 16
_NATIVE_ERROR_LIMIT = 65536
_VOLUME_DEVICE = re.compile(r"/dev/disk[0-9]+(?:s[0-9]+)+\Z")
_EVIDENCE_STRING_LIMIT = 512
_EVIDENCE_ENTITIES = 64
_EVIDENCE_STORES = 8
_DEVICE_NAME_LIMIT = 128
_EVIDENCE_INT_BITS = 128
_IDENTITY_PARTS = 2
_VOLUME_FIELDS = ("DeviceIdentifier", "DeviceNode", "VolumeUUID", "DiskUUID", "VolumeName", "FilesystemType",
                  "MountPoint", "Mounted", "ParentWholeDisk", "APFSContainerReference")


def entities(value: dict) -> list[dict]:
    """Reject malformed native entity lists rather than selecting a guessed device."""
    result = value.get("system-entities")
    require(isinstance(result, list) and all(isinstance(entry, dict) for entry in result),
            "Invalid image device metadata")
    return result


def image_device(value: dict) -> str:
    """Select the partition-map image device, never its separate synthesized APFS container."""
    devices = [entry["dev-entry"] for entry in entities(value)
               if isinstance(entry.get("dev-entry"), str) and _DEVICE.fullmatch(entry["dev-entry"])
               and entry.get("content-hint") in ("GUID_partition_scheme", "Apple_partition_scheme")]
    require(len(devices) == 1, "Image whole-device ownership is ambiguous")
    return devices[0]


def require(condition: bool, detail: str) -> None:
    """Refuse uncertain ownership and retain the fresh fixture rather than targeting another device."""
    if not condition:
        raise RuntimeError(detail)


def command(arguments: list[str]) -> bytes:
    """Fixed native programs only, no shell, with bounded accepted output and a joined timeout."""
    require(arguments[0] in ("/usr/bin/hdiutil", "/usr/sbin/diskutil", "/usr/bin/ditto", "/bin/sync"),
            "Unsupported owned-image program")
    result = subprocess.run(arguments, check=True, timeout=60, capture_output=True)  # noqa: S603 # nosec B603
    require(len(result.stdout) <= _PLIST_LIMIT and len(result.stderr) <= _PLIST_LIMIT, "Oversized native metadata")
    return result.stdout


def plist(arguments: list[str]) -> dict:
    """Decode native structured metadata; human-readable command text is never device authority."""
    value = plistlib.loads(command(arguments))
    require(isinstance(value, dict), "Invalid native image metadata")
    return value


def native_failure(error: subprocess.CalledProcessError) -> dict[str, object]:
    """Retain bounded native failure output even when a later ownership check refuses cleanup."""
    return {"returncode": error.returncode,
            "stdout": (error.stdout or b"")[:_NATIVE_ERROR_LIMIT].decode("utf-8", errors="replace"),
            "stderr": (error.stderr or b"")[:_NATIVE_ERROR_LIMIT].decode("utf-8", errors="replace")}


def _detach_failure(record: dict[str, object], phase: str, error: Exception) -> None:
    record.update(phase=phase, error=str(error)[:2048])
    if isinstance(error, subprocess.CalledProcessError):
        record["native_error"] = native_failure(error)


def _mountpoint_diagnostic(entries: list[dict], allowed: set[Path]) -> str:
    observed = "; ".join(str(entry.get("dev-entry", "<missing>"))[:128] + " -> "
                         + str(entry.get("mount-point", "<unmounted>"))[:512] for entry in entries[:8])
    expected = "; ".join(str(path)[:512] for path in sorted(allowed)[:8])
    return (f"Image escaped the private fixture mountpoint; observed [{observed}] "
            f"({len(entries)} entities); allowed [{expected}] ({len(allowed)} paths)")


def _evidence_fields(value: dict, names: tuple[str, ...]) -> dict:
    result, truncated = {}, []
    for name in names:
        if name not in value:
            continue
        item = value[name]
        if isinstance(item, str):
            result[name] = item[:_EVIDENCE_STRING_LIMIT]
            if len(item) > _EVIDENCE_STRING_LIMIT:
                truncated.append(name)
        elif item is None or type(item) is bool or type(item) is int and item.bit_length() <= _EVIDENCE_INT_BITS:
            result[name] = item
        else:
            result[name] = {"invalid_type": type(item).__name__}
    if truncated:
        result["truncated_fields"] = truncated
    return result


def _attachment_evidence(value: dict) -> dict:
    entries = entities(value)
    return {"image": _evidence_fields(value, ("image-path",)), "entity_count": len(entries),
            "entities_truncated": len(entries) > _EVIDENCE_ENTITIES,
            "entities": [_evidence_fields(entry, ("dev-entry", "content-hint", "mount-point"))
                         for entry in entries[:_EVIDENCE_ENTITIES]]}


def _identity_evidence(value: object) -> list[int] | None:
    if (isinstance(value, tuple) and len(value) == _IDENTITY_PARTS
            and all(type(item) is int and item >= 0 and item.bit_length() <= _EVIDENCE_INT_BITS for item in value)):
        return list(value)
    return None


def _volume_evidence(value: dict) -> dict:
    result = _evidence_fields(value, _VOLUME_FIELDS)
    if "APFSPhysicalStores" in value:
        stores = value["APFSPhysicalStores"]
        if isinstance(stores, list):
            result.update(physical_store_count=len(stores), physical_stores_truncated=len(stores) > _EVIDENCE_STORES,
                          APFSPhysicalStores=[_evidence_fields(item, ("APFSPhysicalStore",)) if isinstance(item, dict)
                                              else {"invalid_type": type(item).__name__}
                                              for item in stores[:_EVIDENCE_STORES]])
        else:
            result["APFSPhysicalStores"] = {"invalid_type": type(stores).__name__}
    return result


class OwnedImage:
    """Only one freshly created private image/device; uncertain detach leaves the scratch directory intact."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        if sys.platform != "darwin" or not os.getuid() or os.geteuid() != os.getuid():
            raise ValueError("Owned APFS validation requires unelevated native macOS")
        self.owned = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="filetree-apfs-owned-")).resolve(strict=True)
        self.anchor = self.owned.stat().st_dev, self.owned.stat().st_ino
        self.name = "FileTree-" + uuid.uuid4().hex
        self.image = self.owned / (self.name + ".sparseimage")
        self.root = self.owned / "volume"
        self.root.mkdir(mode=0o700)
        self._mountpoints = {self.root}
        self.identity: tuple[int, int] | None = None
        self.device, self.volume_uuid = "", ""
        self.attached = False
        self.attach_attempted = False
        self.detach_attempts: list[dict[str, object]] = []
        self._volume_device = ""
        self._attachment_evidence: dict | None = None
        self._checked_volume_evidence: dict | None = None
        self._unmounted_volume_device: str | None = None
        self._detach_binding: VolumeBinding | None = None
        self._unmounted_binding: VolumeBinding | None = None
        self._registered_entities: tuple[tuple[str, str], ...] | None = None
        self._wholly_unmounted = False

    def create(self) -> None:
        """Refuse overwrite: no -ov, existing image, mountpoint or block-device selector is accepted."""
        require(not self.image.exists() and not os.path.ismount(self.root), "Existing fixture target refused")
        command(["/usr/bin/hdiutil", "create", "-size", "1g", "-type", "SPARSE", "-fs", "APFS",
                 "-volname", self.name, str(self.image)])
        info = self.image.lstat()
        require(stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and info.st_uid == os.getuid() and info.st_nlink == 1,
                "Created image is not an owned ordinary file")
        self.identity = info.st_dev, info.st_ino
        self.image.chmod(0o600)

    def _image_check(self) -> None:
        self._scratch_check()
        info = self.image.lstat()
        require(stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and not info.st_mode & 0o077 and info.st_uid == os.getuid()
                and info.st_nlink == 1 and (info.st_dev, info.st_ino) == self.identity,
                "Owned image identity/permissions changed")
    def _scratch_check(self) -> None:
        anchor = self.owned.lstat()
        require(stat.S_ISDIR(anchor.st_mode) and not anchor.st_mode & 0o077 and anchor.st_uid == os.getuid()
                and (anchor.st_dev, anchor.st_ino) == self.anchor, "Owned scratch directory changed")

    def attach(self) -> None:
        """Mount only this freshly created image at its exclusive private mountpoint."""
        self._image_check()
        require(not self.attach_attempted and not os.path.ismount(self.root), "Repeated or existing attach refused")
        self.attach_attempted = True
        result = plist(["/usr/bin/hdiutil", "attach", "-plist", "-nobrowse", "-noautoopen", "-owners", "on",
                        "-mountpoint", str(self.root), str(self.image)])
        self.device, self.attached = image_device(result), True
        info = self.check()
        self.volume_uuid = info["VolumeUUID"]

    def _registered_attachment(self) -> dict:
        self._attachment_evidence = None
        self._unmounted_volume_device = None
        self._registered_entities = None
        self._unmounted_binding = None
        self._wholly_unmounted = False
        self._image_check()
        info = plist(["/usr/bin/hdiutil", "info", "-plist"])
        images = [entry for entry in info.get("images", []) if isinstance(entry, dict)
                  and entry.get("image-path") == str(self.image)]
        require(len(images) == 1, "Fresh image attachment is missing or ambiguous")
        entries = entities(images[0])
        self._attachment_evidence = _attachment_evidence(images[0])
        self._attachment_evidence.update(captured_image_identity=_identity_evidence(getattr(self, "identity", None)),
                                         captured_scratch_identity=_identity_evidence(getattr(self, "anchor", None)))
        require(image_device(images[0]) == self.device, "Owned image device changed")
        self._registered_entities = registration(entries)
        self._wholly_unmounted = all(entry.get("mount-point") is None
                                    or type(entry.get("mount-point")) is str and entry["mount-point"] == ""
                                    for entry in entries)
        return images[0]

    def _attachment(self) -> dict:
        image = self._registered_attachment()
        entries = entities(image)
        points = [entry["mount-point"] for entry in entries if entry.get("mount-point")]
        captured = getattr(self, "_volume_device", "")
        if (not points and isinstance(captured, str) and len(captured) <= _DEVICE_NAME_LIMIT
                and _VOLUME_DEVICE.fullmatch(captured)
                and sum(entry.get("dev-entry") == captured for entry in entries) == 1):
            self._unmounted_volume_device = captured
        if not points or not all(isinstance(point, str) and Path(point).resolve() in self._mountpoints
                                 for point in points):
            raise RuntimeError(_mountpoint_diagnostic(entries, self._mountpoints))
        return image

    def new_mountpoint(self) -> Path:
        """Register only a fresh private sibling for this image's additional owned APFS volume."""
        self.check()
        path = self.owned / ("peer-" + uuid.uuid4().hex)
        path.mkdir(mode=0o700)
        self._mountpoints.add(path)
        return path

    def check(self) -> dict:
        """Check image/device mapping, APFS identity and the exact private volume name/mountpoint."""
        require(self.attached, "Owned image is not attached")
        attachment = self._attachment()
        info = plist(["/usr/sbin/diskutil", "info", "-plist", str(self.root)])
        require(info.get("FilesystemType") == "apfs" and info.get("VolumeName") == self.name
                and info.get("MountPoint") == str(self.root) and os.path.ismount(self.root)
                and isinstance(info.get("VolumeUUID"), str) and bool(info["VolumeUUID"]),
                "Private APFS volume identity is unavailable")
        require(not self.volume_uuid or info["VolumeUUID"] == self.volume_uuid, "Private APFS volume was replaced")
        self._checked_volume_evidence = _volume_evidence(info)
        self._detach_binding = volume_binding(info, self._registered_entities, self.name, self.device)
        identifier = info.get("DeviceIdentifier")
        candidate = "/dev/" + identifier if isinstance(identifier, str) else ""
        if (not getattr(self, "_volume_device", "") and len(candidate) <= _DEVICE_NAME_LIMIT
                and _VOLUME_DEVICE.fullmatch(candidate)
                and sum(entry.get("dev-entry") == candidate for entry in entities(attachment)) == 1
                and any(entry.get("dev-entry") == candidate and entry.get("mount-point") == str(self.root)
                        for entry in entities(attachment))):
            self._volume_device = candidate
        return info

    def _post_busy_volume_evidence(self) -> dict:
        """Observe only the captured volume still uniquely registered in the checked unmounted image."""
        device = self._unmounted_volume_device
        captured = getattr(self, "_volume_device", None)
        expected = getattr(self, "volume_uuid", "")
        result = {"status": "not-eligible",
                  "device": device[:_DEVICE_NAME_LIMIT] if isinstance(device, str) else None,
                  "device_truncated": isinstance(device, str) and len(device) > _DEVICE_NAME_LIMIT,
                  "captured_device": captured[:_DEVICE_NAME_LIMIT] if isinstance(captured, str) else None,
                  "captured_device_truncated": isinstance(captured, str) and len(captured) > _DEVICE_NAME_LIMIT,
                  "expected_uuid": expected[:_EVIDENCE_STRING_LIMIT] if isinstance(expected, str) else None,
                  "expected_uuid_truncated": isinstance(expected, str) and len(expected) > _EVIDENCE_STRING_LIMIT,
                  "uuid_matches": None}
        if (not isinstance(device, str) or len(device) > _DEVICE_NAME_LIMIT or not _VOLUME_DEVICE.fullmatch(device)
                or device != captured or not isinstance(expected, str) or not expected):
            return result
        try:
            info = plist(["/usr/sbin/diskutil", "info", "-plist", device])
        except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
            result.update(status="read-failed", error=str(error)[:2048], exception_type=type(error).__name__)
            if isinstance(error, subprocess.CalledProcessError):
                result["native_error"] = native_failure(error)
            elif isinstance(error, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
                result["timeout_seconds"] = error.timeout
                result["outputs"] = {key: (getattr(error, key, None) or b"")[:_NATIVE_ERROR_LIMIT]
                                     .decode("utf-8", errors="replace") for key in ("stdout", "stderr")}
        else:
            observed = info.get("VolumeUUID")
            matches = observed == expected if isinstance(observed, str) and observed else None
            result.update(status="read", info=_volume_evidence(info), uuid_matches=matches)
            if (getattr(self, "_wholly_unmounted", False)
                    and info.get("MountPoint") in (None, "")
                    and (info.get("Mounted") is None or info.get("Mounted") is False)):
                self._unmounted_binding = volume_binding(info, self._registered_entities, self.name, self.device)
        return result

    def _record_detach_observations(self, record: dict, *, post_busy: bool = False) -> None:
        record["attachment"] = self._attachment_evidence
        record["checked_volume"] = self._checked_volume_evidence
        if post_busy:
            record["post_busy_volume"] = self._post_busy_volume_evidence()

    def _check_detach(self, record: dict, previous_busy: bool) -> None:
        expected = getattr(self, "_detach_binding", None)
        try:
            self.check()
        except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
            self._record_detach_observations(record, post_busy=previous_busy)
            if (not previous_busy or expected is None or self._unmounted_binding != expected
                    or self._unmounted_volume_device != expected.volume):
                raise
            self._registered_attachment()
            require(self._wholly_unmounted and self._registered_entities == expected.registration,
                    "Owned image registration changed during detach recovery")
            self._image_check()
            require(not any(os.path.ismount(point) for point in self._mountpoints),
                    "Owned mountpoint became mounted during detach recovery")
            record.update(mounted_check_error=str(error)[:2048], unmounted_identity_rechecked=True,
                          rechecked_attachment=self._attachment_evidence)
        else:
            self._record_detach_observations(record)

    def detach(self) -> None:
        """Bound checked busy retries; retain each attempt's native output and any later refusal."""
        self.detach_attempts = []
        for attempt in range(_DETACH_ATTEMPTS):
            record: dict[str, object] = {"attempt": attempt + 1, "device": self.device, "phase": "checking"}
            self.detach_attempts.append(record)
            self._attachment_evidence = self._checked_volume_evidence = self._unmounted_volume_device = None
            self._unmounted_binding = None
            previous_busy = bool(attempt and self.detach_attempts[-2].get("native_error", {})
                                 .get("returncode") == _DEVICE_BUSY)
            try:
                self._check_detach(record, previous_busy)
            except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
                _detach_failure(record, "ownership-refused", error)
                raise
            try:
                command(["/usr/bin/hdiutil", "detach", self.device])
            except subprocess.CalledProcessError as error:
                _detach_failure(record, "native-refused", error)
                if error.returncode != _DEVICE_BUSY or attempt == _DETACH_ATTEMPTS - 1:
                    if error.returncode == _DEVICE_BUSY:
                        record["busy_observation"] = observe_busy_image(
                            getattr(self, "image", None), self.device, getattr(self, "_detach_binding", None),
                            getattr(self, "_mountpoints", set()), self._image_check)
                    raise
                delay = .5 * (attempt + 1)
                record["retry_delay_seconds"] = delay
                time.sleep(delay)
            except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
                _detach_failure(record, "native-refused", error)
                raise
            else:
                record["phase"] = "native-succeeded"
                record["native_succeeded"] = True
                break
        try:
            info = plist(["/usr/bin/hdiutil", "info", "-plist"])
            require(not any(entry.get("image-path") == str(self.image) for entry in info.get("images", []))
                    and not os.path.ismount(self.root), "Owned image detach was not verified")
        except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
            _detach_failure(record, "verification-refused", error)
            raise
        record["phase"] = "verified"
        self.attached = False

    def cleanup(self) -> None:
        """Remove disposable fixture metadata only after verified detach; uncertain attachments are retained."""
        require(not self.attached and (not self.attach_attempted or bool(self.device)),
                "Uncertain image attachment retained")
        self._scratch_check()
        if self.identity is not None:
            self._image_check()
        for folder, directories, _files in os.walk(self.owned, followlinks=False):
            require(not os.path.ismount(folder), "Mounted fixture directory retained")
            for name in directories:
                require(not os.path.islink(os.path.join(folder, name)), "Linked fixture directory retained")
        shutil.rmtree(self.owned)
